# Minnesota Timberwolves Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-09, 34:30. https://youtu.be/cFV24VgxyCY

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the 2026/27 Minnesota Timberwolves for fantasy. His main theme is the team's move away from size after trading Naz Reid and Julius Randle. His projected starting five is LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga and Rudy Gobert, but he doubts Kuminga stays a real starter. He thinks Edwards belongs around picks 7 to 8, not 5. He likes Ball in the top 20 for categories and is fine with Gobert and McDaniels at their prices. He thinks Ayo Dosunmu is overvalued at 108 and Terrence Shannon Jr. is overhyped. He sees Joan Beringer only as a stash for formats with deep benches or weekly lineups. Minnesota has a two-game week in the fantasy semifinals (4-2-4 schedule), and he counts that against Edwards and Ball.
